title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act), consolidated version of 27.7.2026, which includes the amendments made by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
fetch: HTTP GET with Accept: application/xhtml+xml and Accept-Language: eng; the resource answered 303 to the cellar URL above, which answered 200
role: reading aid: the Publications Office consolidated version, which says of itself that it is meant purely as a documentation tool and has no legal effect; the Official Journal text is authentic. Recitals are not part of it. The `▼B` and `▼M1` markers of the consolidated version are kept in the text file, one per line.
in_force: The version in force from 27 July 2026 (the entry into force of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, Art 4 there). Later dated consolidations were not enumerated: two web searches on 2026-11-17 found no further amending act.
sha256_of: the XHTML original as fetched (851,286 bytes); not re-deposited here (licence undetermined, as for the other XHTML originals of this subject)
rendered_by: xhtml_to_text.py in this folder (standard library only; run as python3 -I xhtml_to_text.py IN.xhtml OUT.txt): one block per line, a list label joined to its text, a footnote reference as [^N], an exponent as ^N (so 10^25 reads 10^25 and not 1025), table rows as | a | b |, amendment markers as their own lines
checked: A line-matching comparison run on 2026-11-17, after replacing curly quotation marks by straight ones and dropping a leading list label: 1,589 of the 1,612 non-blank lines that the consolidated text marks `▼B` occur verbatim in eu-ai-act-2024-1689.txt, and 224 of the 275 non-blank lines it marks `▼M1` occur verbatim in eu-omnibus-2026-1744.txt. The lines that did not match were not compared one by one in that run: they are the title block, the 'Amended by' table, footnote reference and footnote lines, table rows of Annex XIV, a few lines whose layout differs (and four numeric expressions that the older text renders without their exponent), and a few points and definitions of the amended provisions. This is a reading aid check, not a verification against the Official Journal.
